provenance: Independently viewed all eight supplied portal-browser-03 PNGs with view_image. Synthetic fixture API + Chromium viewport emulation; no real player score or physical device.

F_readability.reason: Rank, anonymous label, score/unit and tie text readable on all four widths; long decimal values fit320px; title wraps with close still visible.

H_production_value.reason: Cream/yellow/dark outlines match existing portal. Uniform row spacing, orderly dividers and clear personal-best box. 12digit anonymous codes intentionally functional rather than expressive.

observations: All eight images keep close button visible. Portrait title wraps; landscape reserves header while content scrolls.
320px long scaled dm scores visibly fit and retain tenths; unit remains visible.
Ranks and scores use clear weight differences; equal900scores labelled同点 on both rows.
Partial bottom row is consistent with scrollable content; it is not evidence of horizontal numeric clipping.
Synthetic labels/huge values are QA fixtures and are not evidence of actual production intake.
limitations: Static panel assessment only; actual motion was not viewed by this reviewer, so no complete eight-category100/motion score is invented.
Images were supplied by portal tester; source-at-review hashes are separate from exact image hashes. Capture-to-source equality needs the main-agent frozen build manifest.
Native dialog keyboard/inert/scroll QA in portal REPORT.json is tester evidence, not this reviewer performing browser interaction.
No human play/physical mobile/screenreader output review.
